_provenance: Categories, section titles, and limits transcribed 2026-09-25 from CV-FRQ_instructions.pdf (FRQ, Juillet 2026) and confirmed structurally identical to the tri-agency CIHR/NSERC/SSHRC "CV commun des trois organismes" (sshrc-crsh.canada.ca instructions page, fetched 2026-09-25). Data, not code (R6): the agent's judgment picks a category per item, this file only enumerates the closed set so a category name cannot drift into a typo.

1.note: Free prose. No item cap; length shares the total page budget with sections 2 and 3.

2.title_fr: Contributions et expériences les plus importantes
2.note: Up to 10 items, each with: description, role played, date/period, and at least one clientele tag.

3.title_fr: Activités de supervision et de mentorat
3.note: Free prose or list. May be marked s.o. / N/A with one short sentence if genuinely not applicable.

page_budget.note: Hard cap per CV-FRQ_instructions.pdf and the tri-agency page. Appendix sections a specific competition may require are excluded from this cap.

frq_old_portal.label: FRQnet - ancien portail (fichier PDF joint)
frq_old_portal.filename_rule: NOM_XXXXX1234_Titre.pdf (max 50 chars, no accent, no space, no special char, one dot before the extension)

frq_new_portal.label: FRQnet - Espace demande (section CV-FRQ, saisie directe)
frq_new_portal.note: No PDF: content is typed/pasted directly into the portal's CV-FRQ web fields. This skill still emits a plain-text companion for that paste-in.

tri_agency.label: CV des trois organismes (CIHR/NSERC/SSHRC, gabarit propre)
tri_agency.note: True Arial is not a standard LaTeX font; the build substitutes Helvetica (helvet/sans-serif default), which is visually close but not byte-identical. Stated rather than silently approximated (R14).
tri_agency.source: sshrc-crsh.canada.ca tri-agency CV instructions page, fetched 2026-09-25
